meta.title: Image of the Celestial Spheres
meta.description: Sorrow is a bitter ice cube floating in a glass of soda, a reflection of the planet in the sky above.

units.rawText: "I've split asunder actions and emotion."
units.displayText: "I've split asunder actions and emotion."

spans.text: "I've split asunder actions and emotion."

units.rawText: "That shocked, bewildered, self-condemning me, is now locked behind the mirror's other side."
units.displayText: "That shocked, bewildered, self-condemning me, is now locked behind the mirror's other side."

spans.text: "That shocked, bewildered, self-condemning me, is now locked behind the mirror's other side."

units.rawText: "The day before I returned to Jiutian, I was thinking..."
units.displayText: "The day before I returned to Jiutian, I was thinking..."

spans.text: "The day before I returned to Jiutian, I was thinking..."

units.rawText: "Why has even the soda turned bitter?"
units.displayText: "Why has even the soda turned bitter?"

spans.text: "Why has even the soda turned bitter?"

units.rawText: Jiutian Sector, Special Starsphere Outer Sector.
units.displayText: Jiutian Sector, Special Starsphere Outer Sector.

spans.text: Jiutian Sector, Special Starsphere Outer Sector.

units.rawText: In the boundless cosmos, the spaceship steadily trudges forward.
units.displayText: In the boundless cosmos, the spaceship steadily trudges forward.

spans.text: In the boundless cosmos, the spaceship steadily trudges forward.

units.rawText: Professor—starboard—!
units.displayText: Professor—starboard—!

spans.text: Professor—starboard—!

units.rawText: Thanks for the reminder.
units.displayText: Thanks for the reminder.

spans.text: Thanks for the reminder.

units.rawText: An interface projects forth with the trajectories of incoming debris. I handle the controls accordingly, the simplified command console interfacing with the propellant system, driving the spaceship towards the left, steering onto a new route clear of debris.
units.displayText: An interface projects forth with the trajectories of incoming debris. I handle the controls accordingly, the simplified command console interfacing with the propellant system, driving the spaceship towards the left, steering onto a new route clear of debris.

spans.text: An interface projects forth with the trajectories of incoming debris. I handle the controls accordingly, the simplified command console interfacing with the propellant system, driving the spaceship towards the left, steering onto a new route clear of debris.

units.rawText: You've gotten used to the controls quickly. Impressive, Professor.
units.displayText: You've gotten used to the controls quickly. Impressive, Professor.

spans.text: You've gotten used to the controls quickly. Impressive, Professor.

units.rawText: These new spaceship models were originally created to be piloted by reserve personnel when astronauts were in short supply. They don't have as much carrying power as the other models either, but they should do fine for you, Professor.
units.displayText: These new spaceship models were originally created to be piloted by reserve personnel when astronauts were in short supply. They don't have as much carrying power as the other models either, but they should do fine for you, Professor.

spans.text: These new spaceship models were originally created to be piloted by reserve personnel when astronauts were in short supply. They don't have as much carrying power as the other models either, but they should do fine for you, Professor.

units.rawText: If you can't spare a hand, hit up the autopilot system.
units.displayText: If you can't spare a hand, hit up the autopilot system.

spans.text: If you can't spare a hand, hit up the autopilot system.

units.rawText: Ah, Croque's here!
units.displayText: Ah, Croque's here!

spans.text: Ah, Croque's here!

units.rawText: After you've got the navigational basics down, you can leave route planning and basic defense to the system.
units.displayText: After you've got the navigational basics down, you can leave route planning and basic defense to the system.

spans.text: After you've got the navigational basics down, you can leave route planning and basic defense to the system.

units.rawText: Though, even if we've made modifications for you and Fresnel's there to help out, I'd advise that you give it some extra practice, rookie.
units.displayText: Though, even if we've made modifications for you and Fresnel's there to help out, I'd advise that you give it some extra practice, rookie.

spans.text: Though, even if we've made modifications for you and Fresnel's there to help out, I'd advise that you give it some extra practice, rookie.

units.rawText: With our remote support and Jiutian's current technology, Anna should be much more assured, right?
units.displayText: With our remote support and Jiutian's current technology, Anna should be much more assured, right?

spans.text: With our remote support and Jiutian's current technology, Anna should be much more assured, right?

units.rawText: I wouldn't be so sure. I'll do what I can to get this spaceship back in one piece first.
units.displayText: I wouldn't be so sure. I'll do what I can to get this spaceship back in one piece first.

spans.text: I wouldn't be so sure. I'll do what I can to get this spaceship back in one piece first.

units.rawText: While Antonina's still in the same place as Xuannu preparing the Analysis System, and isn't here to blast anyone for—
units.displayText: While Antonina's still in the same place as Xuannu preparing the Analysis System, and isn't here to blast anyone for—

spans.text: While Antonina's still in the same place as Xuannu preparing the Analysis System, and isn't here to blast anyone for—

units.rawText: Professor, large debris field ahead, requesting permission to use blasters!
units.displayText: Professor, large debris field ahead, requesting permission to use blasters!

spans.text: Professor, large debris field ahead, requesting permission to use blasters!

units.rawText: Fresnel's voice suddenly interrupts the conversation. She focused herself completely on planning the route, devoting all of her attention. In the center of an information panel, an impossible to ignore symbol signifying a piece of debris approaches our projected path.
units.displayText: Fresnel's voice suddenly interrupts the conversation. She focused herself completely on planning the route, devoting all of her attention. In the center of an information panel, an impossible to ignore symbol signifying a piece of debris approaches our projected path.

spans.text: Fresnel's voice suddenly interrupts the conversation. She focused herself completely on planning the route, devoting all of her attention. In the center of an information panel, an impossible to ignore symbol signifying a piece of debris approaches our projected path.

units.rawText: Combat module, authorize—Fresnel.
units.displayText: Combat module, authorize—Fresnel.

spans.text: Combat module, authorize—Fresnel.

units.rawText: [Authorization Complete.]
units.displayText: [Authorization Complete.]

spans.text: [Authorization Complete.]

units.rawText: Lightbeam reflection... ready!
units.displayText: Lightbeam reflection... ready!

spans.text: Lightbeam reflection... ready!

units.rawText: As Fresnel's voice settles in the air, a thin yet bright beam of light bursts forth diagonally ahead of the spaceship.
units.displayText: As Fresnel's voice settles in the air, a thin yet bright beam of light bursts forth diagonally ahead of the spaceship.

spans.text: As Fresnel's voice settles in the air, a thin yet bright beam of light bursts forth diagonally ahead of the spaceship.

units.rawText: Looking outwards from inside the cabin, the debris in space remains difficult to spot. Following the light beam, a dazzling minute firework detonates in the distance, a soundless spectacle in the vacuum of space.
units.displayText: Looking outwards from inside the cabin, the debris in space remains difficult to spot. Following the light beam, a dazzling minute firework detonates in the distance, a soundless spectacle in the vacuum of space.

spans.text: Looking outwards from inside the cabin, the debris in space remains difficult to spot. Following the light beam, a dazzling minute firework detonates in the distance, a soundless spectacle in the vacuum of space.

units.rawText: Phew...
units.displayText: Phew...

spans.text: Phew...

units.rawText: Good work, Fresnel.
units.displayText: Good work, Fresnel.

spans.text: Good work, Fresnel.

units.rawText: You two seem to work together well enough. No need for me to breathe down your throats then—we'll leave you to it for now. Call if you need anything.
units.displayText: You two seem to work together well enough. No need for me to breathe down your throats then—we'll leave you to it for now. Call if you need anything.

spans.text: You two seem to work together well enough. No need for me to breathe down your throats then—we'll leave you to it for now. Call if you need anything.

units.rawText: ...We'll await your good news.
units.displayText: ...We'll await your good news.

spans.text: ...We'll await your good news.

units.rawText: As the call ends, I look towards Fresnel. She remains fixated on the interface in front of her, observing it diligently with her head down.
units.displayText: As the call ends, I look towards Fresnel. She remains fixated on the interface in front of her, observing it diligently with her head down.

spans.text: As the call ends, I look towards Fresnel. She remains fixated on the interface in front of her, observing it diligently with her head down.

units.rawText: Fresnel.
units.displayText: Fresnel.

spans.text: Fresnel.

units.rawText: Fresnel?
units.displayText: Fresnel?

spans.text: Fresnel?

units.rawText: ...Hm? Professor... were you talking to me?
units.displayText: ...Hm? Professor... were you talking to me?

spans.text: ...Hm? Professor... were you talking to me?

units.rawText: Don't be so nervous, Fresnel.
units.displayText: Don't be so nervous, Fresnel.

spans.text: Don't be so nervous, Fresnel.

units.rawText: Once Antonina's done with her adjustments and preparations, she'll be able to provide remote support. That'll take some of the pressure off you, and make the remainder of the survey easier.
units.displayText: Once Antonina's done with her adjustments and preparations, she'll be able to provide remote support. That'll take some of the pressure off you, and make the remainder of the survey easier.

spans.text: Once Antonina's done with her adjustments and preparations, she'll be able to provide remote support. That'll take some of the pressure off you, and make the remainder of the survey easier.

units.rawText: ...Alright, got it.
units.displayText: ...Alright, got it.

spans.text: ...Alright, got it.

units.rawText: I just...
units.displayText: I just...

spans.text: I just...

units.rawText: She finally removes her sight from the interface, looking into the endless depths.
units.displayText: She finally removes her sight from the interface, looking into the endless depths.

spans.text: She finally removes her sight from the interface, looking into the endless depths.

units.rawText: Outside the cabin between the veils of stars, an area gleaming with purple starlight finally reveals itself.
units.displayText: Outside the cabin between the veils of stars, an area gleaming with purple starlight finally reveals itself.

spans.text: Outside the cabin between the veils of stars, an area gleaming with purple starlight finally reveals itself.

units.rawText: It laid in quietude thus, akin to a deep placid sleep, yet like a siren amongst the seas of stars, swaying and warbling its tantalizing song.
units.displayText: It laid in quietude thus, akin to a deep placid sleep, yet like a siren amongst the seas of stars, swaying and warbling its tantalizing song.

spans.text: It laid in quietude thus, akin to a deep placid sleep, yet like a siren amongst the seas of stars, swaying and warbling its tantalizing song.

units.rawText: I'm just feeling a little bit like a... "stranger in a strange land".
units.displayText: I'm just feeling a little bit like a... "stranger in a strange land".

spans.text: I'm just feeling a little bit like a... "stranger in a strange land".

units.rawText: Is that how you use that phrase? I can't say I really know, since I don't have a way with words like Hubble does...
units.displayText: Is that how you use that phrase? I can't say I really know, since I don't have a way with words like Hubble does...

spans.text: Is that how you use that phrase? I can't say I really know, since I don't have a way with words like Hubble does...

units.rawText: She always knows how to talk to people in a gentle way, how to write great novels... with phrases and passages that just make people want to keep reading with how beautiful they are.
units.displayText: She always knows how to talk to people in a gentle way, how to write great novels... with phrases and passages that just make people want to keep reading with how beautiful they are.

spans.text: She always knows how to talk to people in a gentle way, how to write great novels... with phrases and passages that just make people want to keep reading with how beautiful they are.

units.rawText: She is really, truly amazing.
units.displayText: She is really, truly amazing.

spans.text: She is really, truly amazing.

units.rawText: Fresnel gazes deeply into the mysterious starsphere, not turning away for but a second.
units.displayText: Fresnel gazes deeply into the mysterious starsphere, not turning away for but a second.

spans.text: Fresnel gazes deeply into the mysterious starsphere, not turning away for but a second.

units.rawText: Professor... why must such a good person as Hubble meet such a fate?
units.displayText: Professor... why must such a good person as Hubble meet such a fate?

spans.text: Professor... why must such a good person as Hubble meet such a fate?

units.rawText: Why is it that back then, the one to bear everything wasn't—
units.displayText: Why is it that back then, the one to bear everything wasn't—

spans.text: Why is it that back then, the one to bear everything wasn't—

units.rawText: Fresnel.
units.displayText: Fresnel.

spans.text: Fresnel.

units.rawText: Relegating navigation to the autopilot, I stand up and come to Fresnel's side, lightly rubbing her head.
units.displayText: Relegating navigation to the autopilot, I stand up and come to Fresnel's side, lightly rubbing her head.

spans.text: Relegating navigation to the autopilot, I stand up and come to Fresnel's side, lightly rubbing her head.

units.rawText: This isn't what Hubble would want, you see?
units.displayText: This isn't what Hubble would want, you see?

spans.text: This isn't what Hubble would want, you see?

units.rawText: ...I know.
units.displayText: ...I know.

spans.text: ...I know.

units.rawText: Trust me, Professor. I won't be like this for very long.
units.displayText: Trust me, Professor. I won't be like this for very long.

spans.text: Trust me, Professor. I won't be like this for very long.

units.rawText: Perhaps some would sink downwards in grief and fear, but not me. I... still have a great many things to do.
units.displayText: Perhaps some would sink downwards in grief and fear, but not me. I... still have a great many things to do.

spans.text: Perhaps some would sink downwards in grief and fear, but not me. I... still have a great many things to do.

units.rawText: Her voice is dominated by coolness and maturity as always, but within it hides an almost imperceptible shaking.
units.displayText: Her voice is dominated by coolness and maturity as always, but within it hides an almost imperceptible shaking.

spans.text: Her voice is dominated by coolness and maturity as always, but within it hides an almost imperceptible shaking.

units.rawText: After Hubble... left, I had thought I tidied up my emotions, and that I could... go and deal with what we had to, with a calm mind.
units.displayText: After Hubble... left, I had thought I tidied up my emotions, and that I could... go and deal with what we had to, with a calm mind.

spans.text: After Hubble... left, I had thought I tidied up my emotions, and that I could... go and deal with what we had to, with a calm mind.

units.rawText: That's just what I'm like. I made contact myself, retrieved the data myself, and dealt with the resetted people in the Sectors myself...
units.displayText: That's just what I'm like. I made contact myself, retrieved the data myself, and dealt with the resetted people in the Sectors myself...

spans.text: That's just what I'm like. I made contact myself, retrieved the data myself, and dealt with the resetted people in the Sectors myself...

units.rawText: As if I was numb enough to not have to deal with the fallout when it all eventually comes crashing down.
units.displayText: As if I was numb enough to not have to deal with the fallout when it all eventually comes crashing down.

spans.text: As if I was numb enough to not have to deal with the fallout when it all eventually comes crashing down.

units.rawText: But sometimes I can't help but doubt... have I done everything I need to? Have I done well enough?
units.displayText: But sometimes I can't help but doubt... have I done everything I need to? Have I done well enough?

spans.text: But sometimes I can't help but doubt... have I done everything I need to? Have I done well enough?

units.rawText: You've done what you need to. You've done well.
units.displayText: You've done what you need to. You've done well.

spans.text: You've done what you need to. You've done well.

units.rawText: Letting yourself feel that pain is alright, too. So long as we find it in ourselves to keep moving forward.
units.displayText: Letting yourself feel that pain is alright, too. So long as we find it in ourselves to keep moving forward.

spans.text: Letting yourself feel that pain is alright, too. So long as we find it in ourselves to keep moving forward.

units.rawText: ...Alright. I will.
units.displayText: ...Alright. I will.

spans.text: ...Alright. I will.

units.rawText: Thank you, Professor... I will.
units.displayText: Thank you, Professor... I will.

spans.text: Thank you, Professor... I will.

units.rawText: The sound of incoming communications rings out anew, putting a stop to that short conversation.
units.displayText: The sound of incoming communications rings out anew, putting a stop to that short conversation.

spans.text: The sound of incoming communications rings out anew, putting a stop to that short conversation.

units.rawText: Professor, Xuannu and I's preparations are complete. How are you adjusting?
units.displayText: Professor, Xuannu and I's preparations are complete. How are you adjusting?

spans.text: Professor, Xuannu and I's preparations are complete. How are you adjusting?

units.rawText: No problems so far. Has the Analysis System returned any notable feedback?
units.displayText: No problems so far. Has the Analysis System returned any notable feedback?

spans.text: No problems so far. Has the Analysis System returned any notable feedback?

units.rawText: It's only just been put into place; don't be so hasty. Do you know how much of a nightmare it was to configure properly?
units.displayText: It's only just been put into place; don't be so hasty. Do you know how much of a nightmare it was to configure properly?

spans.text: It's only just been put into place; don't be so hasty. Do you know how much of a nightmare it was to configure properly?

units.rawText: Jiutian's technology is special-built for the Starspheres, and has no functions related to the monitoring and analysis of Entropics at all built-in. Chances are that that's a part of the Sector's design...
units.displayText: Jiutian's technology is special-built for the Starspheres, and has no functions related to the monitoring and analysis of Entropics at all built-in. Chances are that that's a part of the Sector's design...

spans.text: Jiutian's technology is special-built for the Starspheres, and has no functions related to the monitoring and analysis of Entropics at all built-in. Chances are that that's a part of the Sector's design...

units.rawText: Squeal!
units.displayText: Squeal!

spans.text: Squeal!

units.rawText: You... when did you get up there?
units.displayText: You... when did you get up there?

spans.text: You... when did you get up there?

units.rawText: I was wondering where that little guy went while I was busy. Thought it was busy playing or something...
units.displayText: I was wondering where that little guy went while I was busy. Thought it was busy playing or something...

spans.text: I was wondering where that little guy went while I was busy. Thought it was busy playing or something...

units.rawText: Sqqqueal?
units.displayText: Sqqqueal?

spans.text: Sqqqueal?

units.rawText: Probably went and hid in the spaceship when you went up to adjust the instruments...
units.displayText: Probably went and hid in the spaceship when you went up to adjust the instruments...

spans.text: Probably went and hid in the spaceship when you went up to adjust the instruments...

units.rawText: What a pain... no troublemaking, alright?
units.displayText: What a pain... no troublemaking, alright?

spans.text: What a pain... no troublemaking, alright?

units.rawText: Squeal? Sqqqqueal—
units.displayText: Squeal? Sqqqqueal—

spans.text: Squeal? Sqqqqueal—

units.rawText: Don't know whether or not it understood... but it's more or less benign most of the time, so it shouldn't cause any problems.
units.displayText: Don't know whether or not it understood... but it's more or less benign most of the time, so it shouldn't cause any problems.

spans.text: Don't know whether or not it understood... but it's more or less benign most of the time, so it shouldn't cause any problems.

units.rawText: Let's put that to the side for now. We have more important matters.
units.displayText: Let's put that to the side for now. We have more important matters.

spans.text: Let's put that to the side for now. We have more important matters.

units.rawText: Fresnel, the instruments indicate that you'll be inside our Starsphere of interest within ten minutes. What's the spaceship's status?
units.displayText: Fresnel, the instruments indicate that you'll be inside our Starsphere of interest within ten minutes. What's the spaceship's status?

spans.text: Fresnel, the instruments indicate that you'll be inside our Starsphere of interest within ten minutes. What's the spaceship's status?

units.rawText: All green, ready for approach.
units.displayText: All green, ready for approach.

spans.text: All green, ready for approach.

units.rawText: Xuannu, how about you?
units.displayText: Xuannu, how about you?

spans.text: Xuannu, how about you?

units.rawText: My preparations are complete too. I can monitor environmental changes in the Starsphere through the signals sent back by the spaceship and provide corresponding support.
units.displayText: My preparations are complete too. I can monitor environmental changes in the Starsphere through the signals sent back by the spaceship and provide corresponding support.

spans.text: My preparations are complete too. I can monitor environmental changes in the Starsphere through the signals sent back by the spaceship and provide corresponding support.

units.rawText: When the time calls for it, I will also release some of the Sector's authorizations according to the Professor's needs.
units.displayText: When the time calls for it, I will also release some of the Sector's authorizations according to the Professor's needs.

spans.text: When the time calls for it, I will also release some of the Sector's authorizations according to the Professor's needs.

units.rawText: As for the rest, you'll have to see when you get in. Professor, proceed with utmost caution.
units.displayText: As for the rest, you'll have to see when you get in. Professor, proceed with utmost caution.

spans.text: As for the rest, you'll have to see when you get in. Professor, proceed with utmost caution.

units.rawText: I shall temporarily disable the warning issued when routing towards the Starsphere. Issue the command at your convenience.
units.displayText: I shall temporarily disable the warning issued when routing towards the Starsphere. Issue the command at your convenience.

spans.text: I shall temporarily disable the warning issued when routing towards the Starsphere. Issue the command at your convenience.
Approach the Starsphere.

units.rawText: [Route planning complete]
units.displayText: [Route planning complete]

spans.text: [Route planning complete]

units.rawText: [Autopilot initiating]
units.displayText: [Autopilot initiating]

spans.text: [Autopilot initiating]

units.rawText: The spaceship lurches forward briefly, and the world outside the cabin window ripples briefly like the surface of water.
units.displayText: The spaceship lurches forward briefly, and the world outside the cabin window ripples briefly like the surface of water.

spans.text: The spaceship lurches forward briefly, and the world outside the cabin window ripples briefly like the surface of water.

units.rawText: We've arrived at... the edges of the Starsphere's influence.
units.displayText: We've arrived at... the edges of the Starsphere's influence.

spans.text: We've arrived at... the edges of the Starsphere's influence.

units.rawText: Ahead is...
units.displayText: Ahead is...

spans.text: Ahead is...

units.rawText: The interface chugs along in an almost tentative manner, the icon signifying the spaceship steadily blinking. The purple starlight gradually encroaches, yet its approach evades the naked eye. Then—
units.displayText: The interface chugs along in an almost tentative manner, the icon signifying the spaceship steadily blinking. The purple starlight gradually encroaches, yet its approach evades the naked eye. Then—

spans.text: The interface chugs along in an almost tentative manner, the icon signifying the spaceship steadily blinking. The purple starlight gradually encroaches, yet its approach evades the naked eye. Then—

units.rawText: Space was still itself, the very same. Yet everything was different.
units.displayText: Space was still itself, the very same. Yet everything was different.

spans.text: Space was still itself, the very same. Yet everything was different.

units.rawText: Looking in from the outside, the Starsphere emanates an aesthetically appealing and alluring purple. Yet when we place ourselves in it, that color blends into the very space itself, no longer seeming so deep.
units.displayText: Looking in from the outside, the Starsphere emanates an aesthetically appealing and alluring purple. Yet when we place ourselves in it, that color blends into the very space itself, no longer seeming so deep.

spans.text: Looking in from the outside, the Starsphere emanates an aesthetically appealing and alluring purple. Yet when we place ourselves in it, that color blends into the very space itself, no longer seeming so deep.

units.rawText: It transforms the anomalous into the mundane, accepting and welcoming all guests.
units.displayText: It transforms the anomalous into the mundane, accepting and welcoming all guests.

spans.text: It transforms the anomalous into the mundane, accepting and welcoming all guests.

units.rawText: It's working! Professor, unfurl the spaceship's analysis instruments, I'll immediately—
units.displayText: It's working! Professor, unfurl the spaceship's analysis instruments, I'll immediately—

spans.text: It's working! Professor, unfurl the spaceship's analysis instruments, I'll immediately—

units.rawText: The Starsphere monitoring panel's responding too!
units.displayText: The Starsphere monitoring panel's responding too!

spans.text: The Starsphere monitoring panel's responding too!

units.rawText: What... is this?
units.displayText: What... is this?

spans.text: What... is this?

units.rawText: Xuannu and Antonina both fall into silence. The data in front of them is doubtlessly no less shocking than what lies before our eyes.
units.displayText: Xuannu and Antonina both fall into silence. The data in front of them is doubtlessly no less shocking than what lies before our eyes.

spans.text: Xuannu and Antonina both fall into silence. The data in front of them is doubtlessly no less shocking than what lies before our eyes.

units.rawText: Chaotic nebulas, a lawless realm. Celestial bodies, randomly placed as if board game pieces knocked onto the floor, play hosts to vivid astral phenomena that dazzle the senses.
units.displayText: Chaotic nebulas, a lawless realm. Celestial bodies, randomly placed as if board game pieces knocked onto the floor, play hosts to vivid astral phenomena that dazzle the senses.

spans.text: Chaotic nebulas, a lawless realm. Celestial bodies, randomly placed as if board game pieces knocked onto the floor, play hosts to vivid astral phenomena that dazzle the senses.

units.rawText: This is a... miniature solar system?
units.displayText: This is a... miniature solar system?

spans.text: This is a... miniature solar system?

units.rawText: No, not quite. It looks like everything's where it should be, but this place is so chaotic that it has no structure to speak of!
units.displayText: No, not quite. It looks like everything's where it should be, but this place is so chaotic that it has no structure to speak of!

spans.text: No, not quite. It looks like everything's where it should be, but this place is so chaotic that it has no structure to speak of!

units.rawText: The basic rules of physics are still in effect, and our route planning systems still function here.
units.displayText: The basic rules of physics are still in effect, and our route planning systems still function here.

spans.text: The basic rules of physics are still in effect, and our route planning systems still function here.

units.rawText: But... proceed with caution. This place is more akin to...
units.displayText: But... proceed with caution. This place is more akin to...

spans.text: But... proceed with caution. This place is more akin to...

units.rawText: More like an area well and truly controlled by the Entropics... no, it quite literally is!
units.displayText: More like an area well and truly controlled by the Entropics... no, it quite literally is!

spans.text: More like an area well and truly controlled by the Entropics... no, it quite literally is!

units.rawText: Antonina pulls up an information panel, and icons marking Entropization swarm the screen. A patch of darkness lies in an even further place, not unlike a sound sleeper's dreamscape. Hushed and elegant, yet teeming with danger.
units.displayText: Antonina pulls up an information panel, and icons marking Entropization swarm the screen. A patch of darkness lies in an even further place, not unlike a sound sleeper's dreamscape. Hushed and elegant, yet teeming with danger.

spans.text: Antonina pulls up an information panel, and icons marking Entropization swarm the screen. A patch of darkness lies in an even further place, not unlike a sound sleeper's dreamscape. Hushed and elegant, yet teeming with danger.

units.rawText: From the layout, there should be some sort of "overseer" in this area driving these things and steering things into what they are now, but we don't know what that is.
units.displayText: From the layout, there should be some sort of "overseer" in this area driving these things and steering things into what they are now, but we don't know what that is.

spans.text: From the layout, there should be some sort of "overseer" in this area driving these things and steering things into what they are now, but we don't know what that is.

units.rawText: The bad news is that from the differences in the signals after you've made contact, that "overseer" seems to have already—
units.displayText: The bad news is that from the differences in the signals after you've made contact, that "overseer" seems to have already—

spans.text: The bad news is that from the differences in the signals after you've made contact, that "overseer" seems to have already—

units.rawText: Woken up!
units.displayText: Woken up!

spans.text: Woken up!

units.rawText: <size=40>Professor! Above!</size>
units.displayText: Professor! Above!

spans.text: Professor! Above!

units.rawText: The gravity system suddenly shifts, and the floor beneath us lurches.
units.displayText: The gravity system suddenly shifts, and the floor beneath us lurches.

spans.text: The gravity system suddenly shifts, and the floor beneath us lurches.

units.rawText: Sqqqqqueal—!
units.displayText: Sqqqqqueal—!

spans.text: Sqqqqqueal—!

units.rawText: Great pieces of debris fall from the sky, raining down past the cabin windows. The miniature Entropic tumbles down from the control panel, tightly hanging onto my seat.
units.displayText: Great pieces of debris fall from the sky, raining down past the cabin windows. The miniature Entropic tumbles down from the control panel, tightly hanging onto my seat.

spans.text: Great pieces of debris fall from the sky, raining down past the cabin windows. The miniature Entropic tumbles down from the control panel, tightly hanging onto my seat.

units.rawText: It was not the gravity system that was problematic, but that the spaceship's defense systems had already sustained an attack!
units.displayText: It was not the gravity system that was problematic, but that the spaceship's defense systems had already sustained an attack!

spans.text: It was not the gravity system that was problematic, but that the spaceship's defense systems had already sustained an attack!

units.rawText: Fresnel, crank up the defense level, prepare cooperative firepower!
units.displayText: Fresnel, crank up the defense level, prepare cooperative firepower!

spans.text: Fresnel, crank up the defense level, prepare cooperative firepower!

units.rawText: Preparations complete!
units.displayText: Preparations complete!

spans.text: Preparations complete!

units.rawText: Shift to manual piloting!
units.displayText: Shift to manual piloting!

spans.text: Shift to manual piloting!

units.rawText: [Autopilot deactivated.]
units.displayText: [Autopilot deactivated.]

spans.text: [Autopilot deactivated.]

units.rawText: Crap, was it because of the data disturbance just then... I'll sort out the safety levels with Xuannu!
units.displayText: Crap, was it because of the data disturbance just then... I'll sort out the safety levels with Xuannu!

spans.text: Crap, was it because of the data disturbance just then... I'll sort out the safety levels with Xuannu!

units.rawText: With Antonina's rapid calculations, a moving section of the asteroid belt appears in the middle of a panel. The spaceship icon within rapidly flashes as various areas less populated with debris are highlighted.
units.displayText: With Antonina's rapid calculations, a moving section of the asteroid belt appears in the middle of a panel. The spaceship icon within rapidly flashes as various areas less populated with debris are highlighted.

spans.text: With Antonina's rapid calculations, a moving section of the asteroid belt appears in the middle of a panel. The spaceship icon within rapidly flashes as various areas less populated with debris are highlighted.

units.rawText: This danger index... no, turn like indicated. We should take "that" route.
units.displayText: This danger index... no, turn like indicated. We should take "that" route.

spans.text: This danger index... no, turn like indicated. We should take "that" route.

units.rawText: Fresnel, we'll go through the high-density asteroid belt in Area C!
units.displayText: Fresnel, we'll go through the high-density asteroid belt in Area C!

spans.text: Fresnel, we'll go through the high-density asteroid belt in Area C!

units.rawText: Copy!
units.displayText: Copy!

spans.text: Copy!

units.rawText: Help me clear out the obstacles in the way, as well as these few pieces I've marked!
units.displayText: Help me clear out the obstacles in the way, as well as these few pieces I've marked!

spans.text: Help me clear out the obstacles in the way, as well as these few pieces I've marked!

units.rawText: [Targets highlighted.]
units.displayText: [Targets highlighted.]

spans.text: [Targets highlighted.]

units.rawText: Professor! That's a dangerous area!
units.displayText: Professor! That's a dangerous area!

spans.text: Professor! That's a dangerous area!

units.rawText: Just a second!
units.displayText: Just a second!

spans.text: Just a second!

units.rawText: The spaceship inclines greatly, avoiding the incoming astral debris as if traversing through a hail of bullets, cutting a dangerous trail.
units.displayText: The spaceship inclines greatly, avoiding the incoming astral debris as if traversing through a hail of bullets, cutting a dangerous trail.

spans.text: The spaceship inclines greatly, avoiding the incoming astral debris as if traversing through a hail of bullets, cutting a dangerous trail.

units.rawText: It'll work, so long as we get through this thin corridor here—
units.displayText: It'll work, so long as we get through this thin corridor here—

spans.text: It'll work, so long as we get through this thin corridor here—

units.rawText: Ahead of you...
units.displayText: Ahead of you...

spans.text: Ahead of you...

units.rawText: There!
units.displayText: There!

spans.text: There!

units.rawText: Cutting it close with the final piece of debris, the formerly chaotic world before us ravels into clarity. I leave the piloting to the system once again, allowing the spaceship to hover in place.
units.displayText: Cutting it close with the final piece of debris, the formerly chaotic world before us ravels into clarity. I leave the piloting to the system once again, allowing the spaceship to hover in place.

spans.text: Cutting it close with the final piece of debris, the formerly chaotic world before us ravels into clarity. I leave the piloting to the system once again, allowing the spaceship to hover in place.

units.rawText: Safe—at last.
units.displayText: Safe—at last.

spans.text: Safe—at last.

units.rawText: Whew...
units.displayText: Whew...

spans.text: Whew...

units.rawText: Professor, Fresnel, how's the spaceship doing?
units.displayText: Professor, Fresnel, how's the spaceship doing?

spans.text: Professor, Fresnel, how's the spaceship doing?

units.rawText: I turn to inspect a panel when suddenly a voice in my heart speaks.
units.displayText: I turn to inspect a panel when suddenly a voice in my heart speaks.

spans.text: I turn to inspect a panel when suddenly a voice in my heart speaks.

units.rawText: Before I could rejoice in avoiding a crisis, the very same peculiar feeling of being watched that came upon me when I first came to Jiutian flows through my body.
units.displayText: Before I could rejoice in avoiding a crisis, the very same peculiar feeling of being watched that came upon me when I first came to Jiutian flows through my body.

spans.text: Before I could rejoice in avoiding a crisis, the very same peculiar feeling of being watched that came upon me when I first came to Jiutian flows through my body.

units.rawText: That's...
units.displayText: That's...

spans.text: That's...

units.rawText: I look forward into space. The hitherto empty patch of space is now occupied by a very special figure.
units.displayText: I look forward into space. The hitherto empty patch of space is now occupied by a very special figure.

spans.text: I look forward into space. The hitherto empty patch of space is now occupied by a very special figure.

units.rawText: She seems to cast over a look on a whim, followed by a smile, and fades back into the vast depths.
units.displayText: She seems to cast over a look on a whim, followed by a smile, and fades back into the vast depths.

spans.text: She seems to cast over a look on a whim, followed by a smile, and fades back into the vast depths.

units.rawText: ...Hubble?
units.displayText: ...Hubble?

spans.text: ...Hubble?
